purpose: Bind a bounded capability, repository, tool-use and long-horizon mid-training program from one useful 4K parent.
research_basis: The design separates repository structure, verified workflows, executable trajectories, context length and selective loss masking while keeping downstream SFT/RL recipes fixed.

common_contract.parent: One useful 4K production checkpoint with model and optimizer state hash-bound before branching. No arm starts without a qualified parent.
common_contract.continuation: Capability branches keep architecture, tokenizer, optimizer semantics, schedule and sequence length; context branches explicitly change sequence capacity and retain or reset state only under a declared policy.
common_contract.objective: Next-token prediction is the initial objective. Tool and trajectory arms may use output/action-only loss masks only after the adapter, mask counts and resume behavior are qualified.
common_contract.exposure: Match complete-update tokens and allocated GPU-hours within each comparison; report replay, unique tokens, derived tokens and effective example exposure separately.
common_contract.packing: Use best-fit packing for complete repository, reasoning and trajectory records. Do not truncate tool observations, reasoning spans or repository dependency bundles silently.
common_contract.downstream: Use one fixed SFT recipe and one fixed RL-feasibility recipe for linked efficiency evaluation. Downstream runs are charged to the post-training research reservation.
common_contract.evaluation: Hold out repository, issue, task and source families and keep final tests untouched. Report source loss, capability, context retention, recovery and cost.
common_contract.accounting: Count acquisition, teacher generation, environment execution, validation, retries, discarded trajectories, training, evaluation and allocated idle time exactly once.

arms.contract: Use the preceding-stage mixture with matched 4K exposure and the same continuation schedule. This controls for parent age and continuation compute.
Use repository files, dependency-linked records, issues, reviews, pull requests, commits, diffs, tests and tool documentation without synthesized trajectories.
Add validated questions, plans, repairs or workflow records grounded in qualified repository/tool context. Preserve parent IDs, teacher identity, generation settings and rejection reasons.
Use pinned repositories, tool schemas and deterministic sandboxes. Retain success, failure and recovery cases with terminal outcomes, loss masks and environment receipts.

trajectory_contract.mask_policy: Environment observations and user/system context are input only. Model reasoning, plans, tool calls and final actions are supervised when valid. Deliberately retained erroneous segments require an explicit zero-loss mask and recovery label.
trajectory_contract.environment_policy: Run grading in a fresh clean environment with pinned image, repository revision, commands, network policy and hidden-test identity. A textual trajectory without executable outcome evidence is not verified supervision.
trajectory_contract.split_policy: Split by repository, issue family and task lineage before teacher generation or trajectory sampling.

screening.purpose: Small homologous proxies compare replay, source-only repository data, grounded workflows and executable trajectories.
screening.primary_evidence: Matched-exposure coding, tool-use and repository outcomes with source loss, short-task retention, trajectory validity and preparation cost.
screening.promotion_rule: Promote at most one candidate to 1.2B confirmation. A candidate must improve the targeted endpoint without an unacceptable retention, validity or cost regression.

arms.contract: Train complete serialized records with the existing next-token path.
Mask observations and context while supervising model-generated reasoning, plans, calls and answers; report supervised positions and mask fingerprints.

objective_and_packing_study.packing_control: Best-fit packing is required for complete records; random truncation is a separate control only when it preserves the declared loss-mask semantics.

arms.role: Unchanged-domain replay repacked into coherent long records
arms.contract: Keep preceding-stage domain proportions and source-family boundaries while increasing sequence length.
Use qualified multi-file repositories, dependency-linked documents, long workflows and short replay after lineage and useful-context checks pass.

context_study.context_schedule: 4K parent to 16K comparison; 32K is a gated production transition.
endpoints: retrieval across positions and dependency distance

confirmation.selected_candidate: Replay control versus one promoted capability candidate, with the selected objective and packing policy frozen before launch.
confirmation.controls: Same useful parent, model, tokenizer, optimizer policy, exposure, evaluation identities and downstream recipes.
confirmation.claim_boundary: One 1.2B paired confirmation supports a bounded data and optimization result. It does not establish a global mixture optimum, universal agentic scaling law or architecture-independent ranking.

stages.purpose: Repository structure, repair, tool schemas, short workflows and replay.
Multi-file repositories, issue/PR/commit context, dependency-aware repair and verified workflows.
Long coding tasks, repeated tool calls, test failures, recovery, summaries and state tracking.

production_sequence.stretch: 64K or 128K requires a later explicit revision after 32K benefit, memory, throughput and retention are measured.

support_and_reserve.budget_check: 120 proxy screening + 40 objective/packing + 80 context + 80 confirmation + 40 support = 360 mid-training-research GPU-hours.

linked_downstream_evaluation.fixed_sft: Same SFT data, masks, supervised-token exposure, optimizer, schedule and evaluation identities for every retained mid-training arm.
linked_downstream_evaluation.rl_feasibility: Same prompts, environment, verifier, rollout budget and recovery policy; report early adaptation and held-out transfer rather than in-environment reward alone.
efficiency_outputs: SFT loss area and steps to a fixed development target
Capability at matched SFT tokens and allocated GPU-hours
Early RL reward adaptation, held-out transfer and rollout cost
Teacher, verifier, environment and discarded-output accounting

required_gates_before_first_arm: Useful parent checkpoint, model/optimizer identities and changed-data/context continuation contracts are hash-bound.
Selected source families pass source-use, exact/near-duplicate, benchmark and held-out partition gates.
Accepted unique tokens, replay exposure, derivation lineage and preparation cost are finite and recorded.
Trajectory environments, tool schemas, reset/replay behavior, hidden tests and failure/recovery checks are qualified before executable data is admitted.
The selective-loss adapter, mask counts, serialization fingerprint and resume behavior are validated before masked trajectory training.
SFT/RL downstream data, environments, verifiers and evaluation identities are fixed before mid-training results are selected.
GH200 cost and recovery behavior support the matched horizons within the declared reservations.
required_outputs_for_report: Manifest fields, lineage, dependency graphs, contamination status and quality-weighted coverage distributions.
Per-arm source, replay, derived-example, trajectory and environment accounting.
Capability, context retention and recovery versus mid-training tokens and GPU-hours.
SFT convergence, early RL adaptation and held-out transfer under fixed downstream recipes.
Teacher, environment, validation, retry, idle and discarded-data costs.
Negative, inconclusive and conditional-branch outcomes with the same detail as selected results.
boundary: No arm is launch-ready from this packet. It defines a data and optimization study only; a future launch must bind the useful parent, changed-data and context implementations, admitted manifests, downstream packet, runtime measurements and an explicit launch receipt.
